champion.tips: IRELIA TIPS AND TRICKS Look to trade when your Passive is up as it gives you an increased amount of attack speed which will help you when it comes to trading. It’s tempting to use just your Q to farm with. While the mana cost is small, it racks up in the end. Try and focus on using your basic attacks to last hit with. Before engaging or looking for an all in, check the minimap. If you go in just as the enemy Jungler approaches, you will end up dying for it.
champion.builds: THE BEST IRELIA BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR MID IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Irelia Mid build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Conqueror as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, as well as Biscuit Delivery and Jack Of All Trades in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Blade of The Ruined King as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Hullbreaker. For your last 3 items, you should build Wit's End, Death's Dance and finish with Guardian Angel. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 52.5% winrate over 9 668 matches played. Optional Your second option for Irelia Mid build would be to take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Bone Plating with Unflinching in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Blade of The Ruined King, which you should build first, followed by Plated Steelcaps as your second item and Kraken Slayer as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Wit's End, Death's Dance and Guardian Angel. The skill order for this build is Q - W - E. In the current patch, this build has a 51.0% win rate over 3 074 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Press the Attack as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Sudden Impact with Treasure Hunter in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Blade of The Ruined King as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Hullbreaker as a third item. You want to finish the build with Wit's End, Death's Dance and Guardian Angel. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 53.1% win rate across 780 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Irelia Mid build in the current patch, try Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, Lethal Tempo, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand as your primary rune tree, and Bone Plating with Unflinching as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Blade of The Ruined King as your first item, then finish Mercury's Treads as your second item, and Wit's End as third item. The last 3 options are Hullbreaker, Death's Dance and Sundered Sky. The ability order for this build is Q - W - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 50.7% win rate over 140 matches played. Situational Irelia Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Irelia build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Irelia runes page.
